title: Do We Need the Largest LLMs for Every Clinical Decision?
abstract: arXiv:2610.26937v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large clinical language models often require multi-GPU infrastructure, limiting local deployment. We introduce CERTA, a decision-level statistical certificate that determines when a quantized model may substitute for its native BF16 reference and escalates decisions that cannot be certified to it. Across eleven instruction-tuned models, both general-purpose and domain-adapted, from three families (7-72B), we evaluated 2,500 clinical-verification decisions from de-identified patient contexts (2,484 patients), with patient-disjoint calibration and testing. In the higher-power operational analysis, round-to-nearest 8-bit quantization at BF16 storage served 99.8-100% of held-out decisions across all eleven models; formal finite-sample guarantees were assessed separately using the exact split-sample procedure. In the same operational analysis, the class-conditional 4-bit frontier reduced the amortized, BF16-equivalent deployment cost to 25.8%

translated_title: 我们真的需要为每个临床决策都使用最大的大语言模型吗？
translated_abstract: 大型临床语言模型通常需要多GPU基础设施，这限制了本地部署。我们提出了CERTA，一种决策级统计证书，用于判定量化模型何时可以替代其原生BF16参考模型，并将无法通过认证的决策升级至参考模型处理。我们在来自三个模型家族（7-72B）的十一个指令微调模型（涵盖通用模型和领域适配模型）上，评估了来自去标识化患者情境（2,484名患者）的2,500个临床验证决策，校准与测试采用患者不相交的划分方式。在更高检验效能的操作性分析中，采用BF16存储的最近取整8位量化在所有十一个模型上满足了99.8-100%的留出决策；形式化的有限样本保证则使用精确的拆分样本程序单独评估。在相同的操作性分析中，类条件的4位量化前沿方案将摊销后的BF16等效部署成本降低至25.8%。
tldr: 提出CERTA决策级统计认证框架，证明量化后的小型模型可在统计保证下替代大型BF16模型处理绝大多数临床验证决策——8位量化满足99.8-100%的决策，4位量化将部署成本降至25.8%，因此并非每个临床决策都需要最大的LLM。
en_tdlr: CERTA, a decision-level statistical certificate, shows that quantized models can reliably replace BF16 references for clinical decisions—with 8-bit quantization serving 99.8-100% of decisions and 4-bit quantization cutting deployment costs to 25.8%—meaning the largest LLMs are not needed for every clinical decision.
